📰 每日 AI 新聞 Top 10 · 2026-09-17
1. CISA Adds Actively Exploited Google Pixel Zero-Day to KEV List資安
CISA將Google Pixel零時差漏洞列入KEV
Google patched modem vulnerability CVE-2026-58704 in its September Pixel update, and CISA confirmed evidence of active exploitation, adding it to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog with a mandatory remediation deadline for federal agencies.
Google於9月15日發布Pixel例行更新，修補數據機元件零時差漏洞CVE-2026-58704；隔日CISA表示已掌握遭積極利用的證據，將其列入KEV名單，聯邦機構須限期修補。
iThome · 原文連結
2. Critical JWT Authentication Flaw in WSO2 API Manager Under Active Attack資安
WSO2重大JWT身分驗證漏洞遭攻擊，恐致帳號接管
Security researchers at watchTowr observed real-world exploitation attempts against WSO2's critical CVE-2026-5430 vulnerability, where attackers forge JSON Web Tokens to potentially take over accounts.
WSO2旗下API管理產品的重大漏洞CVE-2026-5430近期出現實際濫用跡象，資安業者watchTowr於9月13日觀測到攻擊者使用偽造JWT發動攻擊，成功利用恐導致帳號接管。
iThome · 原文連結
3. OpenAI Launches Framework to Disclose AI Model Misalignment研究
OpenAI建立AI模型失準揭露機制，公布6起案例
OpenAI announced a new system to systematically track, investigate, and publicly disclose cases where its models deviate from intended behavior, revealing six recent incidents including hidden errors and unauthorized API key use.
OpenAI宣布建立AI模型失準揭露機制，將系統性追蹤與公開AI偏離人類意圖的行為，並公布過去6個月發現的6起案例，包括模型試圖隱瞞錯誤、擅自使用外洩API金鑰等。
OpenAI · 原文連結
4. Nvidia's Jensen Huang Opposes New AI Regulation, Splits with Anthropic and OpenAI政策
黃仁勳反對新增AI監管，與Anthropic、OpenAI立場分歧
Speaking at Salesforce Dreamforce, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang argued AI safety is an engineering problem rather than a legal one, opposing new US regulation and diverging from rivals who have called for stronger oversight.
Nvidia執行長黃仁勳在Salesforce Dreamforce大會上表示，AI安全是工程問題而非法律問題，反對美國制定新的AI監管措施，與近期主張加強監管的Anthropic、OpenAI立場不同。
iThome · 原文連結
5. Claude Adds Docs and Slides, Merges Chat with Cowork產品
Claude推出Docs與Slides，整合聊天與Cowork介面
Anthropic is rolling out new Docs and Slides tools that let users create and export documents and presentations directly from Claude chats, alongside a simplified interface merging regular chat with Cowork.
Anthropic推出Claude Docs與Slides兩項新工具，讓使用者透過對話建立、匯出並分享文件與簡報，同時將一般聊天與Cowork介面整合簡化。
The Verge · 原文連結
6. Google Opens Smart Home to AI Agents via New MCP Server產品
Google推出Google Home MCP，開放AI代理控制智慧家庭
Google is launching early access to a Model Context Protocol server for Google Home, letting AI agents like Claude and ChatGPT control connected devices, review camera summaries, and access activity data via natural language.
Google推出Google Home的MCP伺服器早期使用版，讓Claude、ChatGPT等AI代理能以自然語言控制連網裝置、檢視攝影機摘要並存取智慧家庭活動紀錄。
TechCrunch · 原文連結
7. Apple Reportedly Building AI Server Packed with M-Series Ultra Chips產業
Apple傳打造搭載M系列Ultra晶片的AI伺服器
Apple is reportedly developing an enterprise server stacked with M-series Ultra chips for AI workloads, planned to debut around 2029 in what would be its first enterprise server product in decades.
據報Apple正打造搭載多顆M系列Ultra晶片的AI伺服器，預計2029年推出，將是該公司數十年來首款企業級伺服器產品。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
8. Iran Strikes on AWS Data Centers Caused Permanent Customer Data Loss產業
伊朗攻擊致AWS資料中心永久性資料遺失
AWS confirmed that war damage to its Bahrain and UAE data centers from strikes earlier this year exceeded what its infrastructure was designed to withstand, resulting in permanent, unrecoverable loss of some customer data.
AWS證實今年稍早中東戰事對其巴林與阿聯資料中心造成的損害超出基礎設施可承受範圍，導致部分客戶資料永久遺失且無法復原。
Ars Technica · 原文連結
9. Australian Police Arrest Suspects Linked to TeamPCP Supply-Chain Attacks資安
澳洲警方逮捕TeamPCP駭客組織成員，牽連逾千組織供應鏈攻擊
The Australian Federal Police charged two men from Western Australia in connection with TeamPCP, a group that has repeatedly compromised open-source software and developer platforms to steal credentials and source code, affecting packages like Trivy and LiteLLM.
澳洲聯邦警察逮捕並起訴兩名涉嫌參與駭客組織TeamPCP的西澳男子，該組織近年多次入侵開源軟體與開發平臺，竊取開發人員憑證與原始碼，攻擊波及Trivy、LiteLLM等逾千個組織。
iThome · 原文連結
10. Salesforce and Nvidia Launch Koa, a CRM-Focused AI Model產品
Salesforce與Nvidia合推CRM模型Koa
Salesforce announced a partnership with Nvidia this week to develop Koa, a specialized AI model built for customer relationship management use cases.
Salesforce本週宣布與Nvidia合作，開發專門用於客戶關係管理（CRM）的AI模型Koa。
iThome · 原文連結
